name: pocket_watch
description: a silver pocket watch from the wardrobe, wrapped in a handkerchief. engraved: 'property of j. blackwood, head of staff.' the watch has stopped at 3:17 am — the exact same time as the pocket watch in guest area 2.

params.success_message: the watch is ice cold. as you hold it, the second hand twitches once, then begins ticking backward.
